outputs.explanation: The three scatter/bar-style plots (Body weight, LW/BW, FW/BW) show individual mouse data points (black circles for NC, red squares for HFD) overlaid on the mean ± S.D. bars.
Panel B is a macroscopic photograph of gross tissue, not a plot summarizing averaged data.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a dot blot (5mC) and methylene blue staining image, not a plot of averaged data.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification bar chart displays individual data points (dots) for each NC and HFD sample overlaid on the bars.

The bottom quantification bar chart (TETs/GAPDH ratio) shows individual data points overlaid on the bars for TET1, TET2, and TET3 in both NC and HFD groups; the upper western blot images themselves are not a plot type requiring this check.
